message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking. The tower is about 330 m tall and has a surface area of roughly 10,000 m². If you were to paint it with a standard industrial paint job (including primer, topcoat, and multiple layers), you’d need a crew of about 50–60 painters working full‑time. With that crew, you could cover about 200–250 m² per day. That means it would take roughly 40–50 days of continuous work to finish the job. In practice, weather delays, safety inspections, and logistical constraints would push the schedule out to about 3–4 months.
